'''Mark Peterson''' played the [[2012 US Nationals]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://starwarsccg.org/phocadownload/2012/2012NationalsDay1.pdf 2012 US Nationals], starwarsccg.org</ref>

== Players Committee roles ==

Mark Peterson (forum handle ''lukesbionichand'') served as Rules Advocate of the [[Players Committee]].<ref name="pc-countdown">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=921494#p921494 Countdown: The 20 most influential volunteers in the PC era], post by AnakinSolo (23 November 2014), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums; lists Rustan Sharer &ldquo;rogue4&rdquo; (Communications Advocate) and Mark Peterson &ldquo;lukesbionichand&rdquo; (Rules Advocate)</ref> The starwarsccg.org About page of 13 December 2013 lists the handle LukesBionicHand as Rules Advocate.<ref name="pc-about2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20131213093658/http://www.starwarsccg.org/about/ About], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 13 December 2013)</ref> See [[Players Committee advocates]].
